long_biography.plain_text:
Inglessis entered the family business in 1981 as chartering director at Pegasus Shipping Services. A decade later he joined cousins in re-establishing Samos Steamship and its London chartering arm, Alberta Shipbrokers. Their expansion combined second-hand acquisitions with a sustained programme of Japanese-built tankers, bulk carriers and gas ships.

He separated his interests from Samos to create Alberta Shipmanagement with daughters Ismini and Alexia. As chief executive, he has continued fleet renewal across tanker and dry-bulk markets while adding new vessel classes. His wider industry service included five years chairing the UK P&I Club, where he guided the mutual insurer through pandemic disruption and volatile investment markets.
